title: Signature Run Ledger
summary: Signature-authored tracking spec: every run as an immutable ledger entry with full provenance.
details: Signature Run Ledger is a JAH-designed experiment tracking specification: each run is an append-only ledger entry containing config, code hash, data version, environment digest, seeds, metrics stream, and artifact hashes. Entries are hash-chained so history cannot be silently rewritten. The design is implementable on any backend. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Ledger entry
demo.program:
import hashlib, json
entry = {"config": {"lr": 3e-4}, "code": "git:9f8e", "prev": "abc123"}
entry["hash"] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(entry, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
print("ledger hash:", entry["hash"])

title: JAH Experiment Time Machine
summary: Signature-authored method: one command restores any run's exact code, data, and environment.
details: JAH Experiment Time Machine is a JAH-designed reproducibility method: given a run ID, a single command checks out the code commit, fetches the dataset version, rebuilds the container, and restores seeds — reproducing the run bit-for-bit. The design specifies the provenance bundle format making it possible. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Restore manifest

title: Signature Metric Atlas
summary: Signature-authored dashboard spec: metrics organized as a navigable atlas, not a table.
details: Signature Metric Atlas is a JAH-designed visualization spec: metrics live in a hierarchical atlas (project > experiment > run > metric), with linked views — click a point to see its config, code diff, and artifacts. The design specifies the navigation grammar so any implementation feels the same. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.program:

title: JAH Config Crystallizer
summary: Signature-authored method: freeze the effective config (with all overrides resolved) per run.
details: JAH Config Crystallizer is a JAH-designed method: at run start, the full effective configuration — defaults plus every override, with sources annotated — is serialized ('crystallized') and hashed. Two runs with the same crystal are the same experiment. The design ends 'works on my machine' config drift. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Crystallize config
demo.program:
import hashlib, json
cfg = {"lr": 1e-4, "batch": 32, "_sources": {"lr": "cli", "batch": "default"}}
crystal = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(cfg, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
print("config crystal:", crystal)

title: Signature Artifact Vault
summary: Signature-authored registry spec: content-addressed artifacts with lineage and retention policies.
details: Signature Artifact Vault is a JAH-designed artifact registry spec: every artifact stored by content hash, linked to its producing run, with retention policies (keep best-N, keep production lineage) and garbage collection. The design prevents both artifact loss and storage bloat. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Vault retention
demo.program:
artifacts = [{"id": "a1", "score": 0.9}, {"id": "a2", "score": 0.7}]
kept = sorted(artifacts, key=lambda a: a["score"], reverse=True)[:1]
print("kept:", [a["id"] for a in kept])

summary: Signature-authored method: lineage links woven automatically at artifact creation.
details: JAH Lineage Weaver is a JAH-designed method: every artifact creation call automatically records parents (code, data, run), weaving the provenance DAG without manual logging. The design specifies the link schema so lineage queries work across tools. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

title: JAH Reproducibility Seal
summary: Signature-authored certification: a run earns the seal only if a stranger can rerun it.
details: JAH Reproducibility Seal is a JAH-designed certification: an independent verifier reruns the experiment from the provenance bundle on fresh infrastructure; if metrics match within tolerance, the run earns the seal. The design specifies tolerance bands per metric type. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

demo.title: Seal check
demo.program:

print("SEALED" if abs(orig-rerun) <= tol else "NOT SEALED")

title: JAH Dataset Freezer

details: JAH Dataset Freezer is a JAH-designed method: before training, the exact dataset slice is snapshotted with checksums and a manifest; the run references the frozen snapshot, never a live path. The design ends 'the data changed under me' irreproducibility. Labeled Signature; an original JAH procedure.

title: Signature Drift Watcher
summary: Signature-authored monitor: detect when production data drifts from training data.
details: Signature Drift Watcher is a JAH-designed monitoring spec: track input feature and prediction distributions in production versus training baselines, alerting on statistically significant drift. The design closes the loop from deployment back to retraining decisions. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.title: Drift statistic
demo.program:
import statistics
train = [0.5]*100; prod = [0.7]*100
shift = abs(statistics.mean(prod)-statistics.mean(train))
print("mean shift:", shift, "->", "ALERT" if shift > 0.1 else "ok")
